title: Tower of Literal Randomness
description: A Roblox competitive multiplayer, tower platformer with random generation game, where players race upward for the highest score. Also a love letter to math.random().

title: The Night Train: Bronzeridge
description: A showcase experience made in Roblox, based off The Night Train, canonically depicting the station of Bronzeridge.

title: The Night Train
description: A showcase experience made in Roblox depicting a metro train, inspired by the Netherland's NS train and Hong Kong's MTR interior design.

title: The Apartment
description: A showcase experience made in Roblox, mainly on the interior design of an apartment, inspired by the book Kitchen by Mahoko Yoshimoto.

title: FourWing
description: A showcase experience made in Roblox, present a chaotic dynamical systems with audio-play, inspired by Elttob's Generative Music.

title: wave.wav
description: A feature showcase made in Roblox, this feature is now implemented in The Apartment. It's a sound visualizer based from the game Drive World.

title: rain.mp4
description: A feature showcase made in Roblox, this feature is now implemented in The Night Train. It's a rain droplet on glass VFX, inspired by Z0LL's droplets effect in Shanyue.

title: Doggone
description: A 2.5D local co-op platformer, play as 2 different dogs, solving puzzles using their own features / abilities.
